draw_line_to_bronze_chests.label: Draw lines to bronze coffers
draw_line_to_bronze_chests.tooltip: Render a line from your character's position to nearby bronze coffers, while out of combat.

draw_line_to_silver_chests.label: Draw lines to silver coffers
draw_line_to_silver_chests.tooltip: Render a line from your character's position to nearby silver coffers, while out of combat.

cast_treasure_sight_before_hunt.label: Cast Treasuresight on the first hunt
cast_treasure_sight_before_hunt.tooltip: When this territory's coffer count is not initialized, unmount, switch to Freelancer, cast Treasuresight, and restore the previous support job; later starts reuse the tracked count

cast_treasure_sight_upon_return.label: Initialize Treasuresight after returning
cast_treasure_sight_upon_return.tooltip: Cast Treasuresight after returning only when this territory's coffer count is not initialized; it is not recast on every return

show_percentage_active_treasure_count.label: Show active treasure as percentage
show_percentage_active_treasure_count.tooltip: Show active treasure as percentage next to the total
